commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' One of the players from Atalanta times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+3' Tommaso Martinelli makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) after a cross from the side. Atalanta force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+2' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) latches on to an accurate cross inside the box and quickly shoots, but unluckily for him one of his own teammates gets in the way of the ball and blocks the shot.
90+2' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
90+1' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) for Nicolas Gonzalez.
88' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) replaces Michael Kayode.
87' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
85' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
85' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
84' Problems for Gian Piero Gasperini as Giorgio Scalvini is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) replaces him.
83' It doesn’t look good for Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
82' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
81' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
79' The ball goes out for a corner. Fiorentina can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Substitution. Alfred Duncan makes way for Gino Infantino (Fiorentina).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) replaces Lucas Beltran.
75' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
75' Here is a change. Rafael Toloi is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta).
74' Here comes a substitution. El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Charles De Ketelaere.
74' The corner is flicked onto Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the right post.
74' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

73' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
72' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
69' Substitution. Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) on for Alfred Duncan.
69' Here's the change. Lucas Beltran leaves the pitch and Gino Infantino (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
68' The current number of corner kicks is 2:2.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Gaetano Castrovilli.
64' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
62' Daniele Orsato couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) and blew his whistle.
60' The game is interrupted. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
57' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Emil Holm will be replaced by Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta).
56' A substitution has been made. Ademola Lookman goes off and Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) comes on.
54' The linesman raises his flag. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
53' Corner kick. Fiorentina will have an opportunity.
50' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but the ball goes narrowly wide of the left post.
49' Tommaso Martinelli displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
47' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to find Ademola Lookman, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Fiorentina get a corner.
45+1' 2 - 3 Goal! Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 2:3.
44' A goal, which was scored by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina), was disallowed due to offside.
42' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
39' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
38' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

36' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Orsato with no other option than to blow for a foul.
34' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.

32' 2 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Tommaso Martinelli just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:2.
31' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' 53:47 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
28' Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
27' Atalanta fail to score from a corner as Tommaso Martinelli (Fiorentina) leaps to collect the ball.
26' Emil Holm (Atalanta) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
25' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Orsato has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
21' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Emil Holm (Atalanta), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post.
19' 1 - 2 Superb finish! Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) latches on to a stunning cross inside the box and slams it past the helpless goalkeeper. The ball flies in off the right post.
17' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
14' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Atalanta was in an offside position.
12' 1 - 1 Goal! Charles De Ketelaere slips in Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) for a one-on-one with the keeper, and he simply dinks the ball over him into the net.
11' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) picks up a long through ball, but Marco Carnesecchi deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
8' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

6' 0 - 1 Goooooal! Gaetano Castrovilli beats his man and slings in a cross towards Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the bottom right corner from close in. 0:1.
5' The ball is cleared after Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' The Atalanta players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Orsato.
